svg.text: for step in start_step:maxS main_SphCon.jl, one time step, (1) to (13)
carried over from the previous step are the markers (position, temperature, composition) and the strain rate used by the viscosity
T_c = Σ_m w_m φ_m T_m / Σ_m w_m φ_m (φ bilinear weight, w marker measure)
composition (depletion, basalt, piles) is projected the same way
η = clamp( η0(layer) · exp[ E (1/T − 1/T_ref) ], η_min, η_max ), E = E_s + V_s ρ0 g z
E_s = 200 K, V_s = 0.0, T_ref = 1600 K; composite laws with cfg.useCompositeRheology (Rheology page)
melt fraction, depletion, crust, latent heat
off by default; switched on by cfg.useMeltingPhase and cfg.trackBasalt
α = α_s + (α_c − α_s) z/D, T_ad = T_pot exp{ (g/c_p) [α_s z + (α_c − α_s) z²/(2D)] }
cfg.compressibilityMode = "ALA"; T_pot = 1350 K, Γ = 1.1, c_p = 1250; Boussinesq uses ρ0 and cfg.alpha
b_r = ρ_ref g α (T − T̄) − g (Δρ_phase + Δρ_Clapeyron + Δρ_comp)
T̄ is the mean over θ at each radius, so only lateral anomalies drive flow; phase and composition terms are zero here
solved for v̄ = v D/κ, η̄ = η/median(η), b̄ = b D³/(η_ref κ), then net rotation removed
repeated until max|v| changes by < cfg.picardTol (cfg.picardMax sweeps; 0 = 50 with a yield law, else 1); η is rebuilt only on the composite path
ε̇_II = sqrt( ½ ε̇:ε̇ ), Φ = 2η ε̇:ε̇ = 4η ε̇_II²
whole-shell check, ∫ b·v dV / ∫ Φ dV = 1.022 (a Stokes solution gives 1)
dt = max( min( cflSafety · Δx_min / max|v|, dtMax, 1.15 dt_prev ), dtMin )
cflSafety = 0.35, Δx_min = min(Δr_min, r_1 Δθ) = 60 km; first step has no 1.15 dt_prev bound; then the CMB temperature (11)
dt = 497 kyr for the whole grid
dt = 497 kyr for the whole grid
dr/dt = V_r, dθ/dt = V_θ / r (RK4, velocity interpolated to each marker)
markers carry T and composition; the grid T is projected again afterwards
Q = −ρ_ref α g T V_r + Φ [+ latent + magmatic heat]
Q_ad and Φ together, only under ALA with cfg.useShearHeating; radiogenic H by cfg.useRadiogenicHeating (off)
(I − θ dt L) T* = (I + (1−θ) dt L) T + dt [ H/c_p + Q/(ρ_ref c_p) ]
L T = (1/r^m) ∂_r(r^m κ ∂_r T) + (κ/r²) ∂²_θ T, markers receive s (T* − T_adv − ΔT_sub)
θ = 0.5 (Crank-Nicolson), κ(z) = κ0 [1 + ½ (z/D)²], T_surf, T_cmb at the wall faces; s = cell measure / marker weight, ΔT_sub the sub-grid relaxation
